module: gameplayStatistic module that measures the time the vehicle is fully airborne: ground speed > 6 m/s, no wheel in contact (contactMaterialID1 and 2 = -1) and vehicle up axis within 45° of vertical (z > 0.707). On landing, if the duration exceeds 0.1 s, adds the metric 'vehicle/airtime.time' (aggregated).
notes: Unloads itself (onExtensionLoaded returns false) if the main controller is not 'vehicleController/vehicleController' or if the vehicle has no wheels.
Ignored if the wheel count has changed since load (lost wheel).
Time is measured with obj:getSimTime(). The code contains a 'todo redo this' comment on the tilt test.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called on load: stores the wheel count; returns false to unload if the vehicle is not suitable.

workload.desc: Watch function run in turn by gameplayStatistic: updates the 'airborne' state and sends the metric on landing.
